text:
Aisha Rao: Quick follow-up from last night's DB/cache saturation incident — pulled notes from the postmortem. We need concrete owners for runbook/playbook edits and a short remediation timeline. Recurring pattern is cache eviction spikes during nightly bulk jobs.
Ben Kim: I can take the playbook edits for mem-pressure triage. ETA EOD Thu.
Ben Kim: Draft triage commands I want to add:
```kubectl top pods -n inference | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl logs -n inference $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=kv-cache -o name) --tail=200
``` 
Carlos Mendez: I'll own the remediation RFC for bulk job scheduling/backoff and coordinating with data infra. Filing a ticket now.
Samir: For context, thresholds we hit: memory ~92% on gpu-node-07, swap thrash observed, eviction spikes matched bulk job windows 00:15-01:10 UTC.
Tess: incident-bot created INF-2137 and a runbook PR draft is linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/42
incident-bot: Created Jira INF-2137: "Bulk-job backoff + runbook triage for cache pressure" assigned to Carlos Mendez, due 2026-04-05.
Aisha Rao: Proposed playbook additions (short):
- Triage checklist: check `kubectl top` for mem>85% on any gpu node AND queue length>50
- If condition met: scale down batch size for affected routes, route traffic to lower-throughput pool, and notify infra oncall
- Quick rollback command:
```redwood route set --model my-model --variant small --reason 'failover'``` 
Ben Kim: I'll add those steps. Also adding a "hotfix flow" with quick rotation commands for kv-cache:
```kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-cache -n inference``` 
Carlos Mendez: RFC INF-2137 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2137 — RFC due 2026-04-05, implementation start target 2026-04-12.
Tess: Can someone own a recurring-pattern monitor? We should catch these bulk-job windows and alert before severe evictions. Suggest Grafana query: `sum(rate(cache_evictions[5m])) by (job)` and daily grouping.
Samir: I'll own the Grafana alert and dashboard panel. Targeting next Tue for a draft alert rule.
Aisha Rao: Owner & deadline summary (please copy into Jira INF-2137):
- Playbook mem-pressure edits: Ben Kim — due 2026-03-30
- Bulk-job scheduling RFC + plan: Carlos Mendez — RFC due 2026-04-05
- Grafana recurring-pattern alert: Samir — due 2026-03-31
- Runbook PR review + merge: Tess + Ben — review complete by 2026-03-29
Action items: add explicit escalation path to infra oncall, include commands above in playbook, add health-check gating for nightly jobs.
Ben Kim: ack :thumbsup:
Tess: I'll post a short PR review checklist in the PR thread and add reviewers. Will also add a line in the playbook for "who to page" with escalation order.
Carlos Mendez: Will update INF-2137 with milestones and link to the runbook PR today.
Aisha Rao: Thanks all. I'll check back Friday for status updates and will mark any blocked items.
Samir: ping if you want me to pair on the alert query this week.
Ben Kim: thanks — I'll kick off the playbook edits and add the commands as code blocks so oncall can copy/paste.
